استرضين (form X)
# اِسْتَرْضَيْنَ (istarḍayna) /is.tar.dˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اُسْتُرْضِينَ (usturḍīna) /us.tur.dˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اِسْتَرْضِينَ (istarḍīna) /is.tar.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
